## Gazetted Officer and certificate services

- Eligible document attestation after checking original documents
- Aadhaar enrolment or update-form verification using the applicable UIDAI format
- Eligible life certificates, including pension-related requests
- PAN application or correction supporting-document attestation where accepted
- Address-proof document and declaration verification where accepted
- Medical fitness certificates following examination
- Medical leave certificates when clinically justified
- Medical Certificate of Cause of Death only in legally and medically appropriate circumstances

All attestation and certification services depend on identity checks, original documents, physical appearance where required, clinical assessment where applicable, the receiving authority's rules and the doctor's official authority and availability.
